_comment: Soldiers 5d sweep seed 9100019 shape: the Vial-put order inside a breakpoint CONTINUATION. Four Plains, Vial on 2, hand Recruiter of the Guard + Cathar Commando (MV2). Cast Recruiter -> fetch Champion of the Parish, cast the Champion, THEN Vial-put the Commando: Champion takes +1 and the T5 swing is Recruiter 1 + Champion 2 + Commando 3 = 6 = lethal. The Champion is not in hand before the tutor resolves, so this order exists only as a continuation; continuation lists were never twinned (AppendVialOrderVariants returned at g_bp_enum_depth > 0). 2026-10-06: the before/after Vial-timing axis is GONE (USER: Vial puts are sequenced like casts, in the deck's cast order). Pinned to MTG_SOLDIERS_ORDER=1 -- the USER-PROPOSED Soldiers order (Champion rank 1), still pending the user's adoption decision -- because under the generic order every creature ties at rank 10 and the tie falls to plan-vector order, which puts the Commando ahead of the Champion (T6). This fixture tests that a CONTINUATION sequences its put by the deck order; it does not adopt that order.
